Health data in My Fitness Diary

What MFD reads
With your permission, MFD reads two kinds of data from Health Connect: your sleep sessions and your step counts. It reads nothing else, and it never writes to Health Connect.

How it is used
Only to fill in your recovery check-ins (Progress → Recovery): hours slept and steps for each of the last 7 days. Sleep is only filled in on days you haven't entered it yourself. MFD reads this only while the app is open.

Where it goes
The hours and step counts are saved in your own diary, in your MFD account, like everything else you log. They are not shared with friends, not sent to ChatGPT, Claude or any other service, not used for ads, and never sold.

Your control
You can stop at any time: Health Connect → App permissions → My Fitness Diary. Check-ins already filled in stay in your diary until you delete them (Progress → Recovery → ⋮ → Delete check-in).
